Firstly, it is essential to understand that intelligence is not solely defined by IQ scores, which are a crude measure of cognitive ability. Intelligence encompasses a broader spectrum of skills, including emotional intelligence, creativity, and adaptability. These hormonal differences can influence cognitive development and performance throughout an individual's life.
